_note: Project-owned redirects, merged into the Worker manifest after the WordPress SEO export. The CSV is a generated artifact (scripts/wp-export.mjs --refresh overwrites it), so hand-written rules live here instead. Same validation as the CSV rows: unsupported statuses, self-redirects, sources colliding with a live route and un-resolvable targets all fail the build. Chains are flattened, so the legacy rows pointing at a withdrawn product follow its redirect.
_freeDownloadsNote: The 31 free-download posts and their library hub were deleted from the site. They are indexed live URLs with backlinks, they return at these same URLs later, and /top-ranking/ is the closest buying-intent match — so they 301 rather than 404. DELETE these rules in the same change that restores the posts: check-routes fails when a redirect source becomes a live route.
_emptiedArchivesNote: The Gold (XAUUSD) Trading archive and its two children lost every post to that deletion, so Astro no longer generates them. They 301 to the blog index, matching how build-redirects.mjs already retires the other empty archives. Remove these rules if the categories refill.
_wooPagesNote: WooCommerce plugin/account endpoints with no equivalent in the rebuild and no search value. Sent to the shop rather than left as dead ends.
_liveChartNote: /live-chart/ and /tools/live-charts/ rendered the same TradingView widget with no canonical pointing at the other, so they competed for one query. The tools page wins: the content page was deleted and both /live-chart/ and the legacy /market-sentiment/ funnel now land there. Restoring the page would collide with these sources and fail check-routes.
_withdrawnProductNote: Nexora Manus is a draft pending republication, so its page no longer builds. Its URL keeps working by redirecting to Zenith, a live AI gold scalper in the same range — so anyone following a link, a bookmark or a legacy redirect still lands on a product. The four legacy rows that point at Nexora follow this one, because chains are flattened. Undrafting Nexora makes /product/nexora-manus-ea-ai-gold-scalper-for-mt5/ a live route again, which collides with this source and fails check-routes — delete this rule in the same change that republishes the product.
_revivalNote: 2026-10-22 revival: absorbed troubleshooting posts 301 to the two merged guides; BBP product URL to its review; Gemini settings URL to the settings guide post.
_categoryMergeNote: The 2026-10-30 taxonomy consolidation folded eleven near-synonym category archives into broader ones (nine here; Brokers & Trading Platforms was kept). Each retired archive 301s at its single best surviving match. The Gold (XAUUSD) Trading archive and its two children are live again, so their old redirects were removed in the same change.
_emptiedCategoriesNote: 2026-11-02: archives of old WordPress categories that hold no posts redirect to the nearest live category, so those legacy URLs do not 404.
